title: Roofing Safety Basics
objective: Learn the 3 most critical safety rules for roofing work

slides.title: Welcome to Safety Basics
slides.content: In the next 4 minutes, you'll learn the three most important safety rules that every roofer must follow. These rules can save your life.
slides.keyTakeaway: Safety is not optional - it's essential for every job.

slides.title: Rule #1: Always Use Fall Protection
slides.content: Falls are the leading cause of death in roofing. Always wear a properly fitted harness and connect to an anchor point before stepping onto any roof over 6 feet high.
slides.keyTakeaway: No harness = No roof access. Period.

quiz.question: At what height must you use fall protection?
quiz.explanation: OSHA requires fall protection at 6 feet or higher. However, many companies require it at all heights as a best practice.

slides.title: Rule #2: Inspect Your Equipment Daily
slides.content: Before each shift, inspect your harness, ropes, and anchors for wear, cuts, or damage. A damaged harness won't save you in a fall.
slides.keyTakeaway: 5 minutes of inspection = a lifetime of safety

slides.title: Rule #3: Never Work Alone
slides.content: Always have a partner on site. If something goes wrong, you need someone who can call for help immediately.
slides.keyTakeaway: Two-person minimum on every roofing job

quiz.question: Why should you never work alone on a roof?
options: It's more fun with a partner
Someone can call for help if needed
quiz.explanation: While all these might be true, the primary reason is safety. In an emergency, immediate help can be the difference between life and death.

quickWin.title: Safety Champion
quickWin.description: You completed this module in under 5 minutes!
